title: session.noted@1
description: Your words sent from the app into a session (session.note, #1577), in the record before the hub says it has them; a write that fails refuses the send. A note with no user.ask of its session carrying its request ID yet is still on its way, after a restart too, and one delivered stays known, so a late retry sends nothing. Only the core appends it.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

session.description: The session the words go to, by its ID, as its hooks carry it.

text.description: The note's words, scrubbed, as the session will read them.

request.description: The delivery's request ID, as the app sent it: the user.ask that delivers the note carries the same one (#340).
